channel.title: Crypto Record
channel.description: Crypto Record reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto market.

item.title: Coinbase adds Ripple’s RLUSD across its trading platforms
item.description: Coinbase added Ripple’s RLUSD on Oct. 28 across Prime, Exchange and its app, with three-network transfers and 1:1 dollar conversion widening access.

item.title: DTCC launches token service for $30 trillion in securities
item.description: DTCC launched a service for tokenized securities, with 20 firms signed up and 34 eligible assets worth about $30 trillion, according to CoinDesk.

item.title: Aviva puts £22bn sterling fund share class on XRP Ledger
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple put a tokenized share class of the £22 billion sterling liquidity fund on XRPL, adding on-chain access while fund assets stay off-chain.

item.title: Aviva and Ripple put £22bn sterling fund shares on XRPL
item.description: Aviva Investors and Ripple have launched a tokenised share class of a £22bn sterling fund on XRP Ledger, adding on-chain access while the fund stays off-chain.

item.title: Solana’s Alpenglow upgrade cuts finality to about 150 milliseconds
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on October 21, replacing TowerBFT with validator vote certificates and targeting faster settlement while keeping wallets and fees unchanged.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin for PayMe payments in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC has launched RedCoin for PayMe, with wallet access rolling out to 3.3 million users for transfers and merchant payments under Hong Kong’s stablecoin regime.

item.title: How a tron swap works, from wallet to confirmation
item.description: A first tron swap moves through a wallet, a token contract and a liquidity pool; learn what to check, sign and confirm before the tokens arrive.

item.title: OCC leaves crypto exchange stablecoin rewards open under GENIUS rule
item.description: The OCC's GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying yield directly but leaves exchange reward programs subject to case-by-case review, starting Jan. 18.

item.title: How Oracle Slippage Limits Work in Chainflip Internal Swaps
item.description: Chainflip internal swaps compare execution with a live oracle limit and retry when the price moves too far; here is how the guard, deadline and refund work.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT with direct validator voting that targets 150ms finality while leaving wallets, fees and app execution unchanged.

item.title: Uniswap v4 hooks bring outside liquidity to three chains
item.description: Uniswap’s v4 Aggregator Hooks went live on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain, routing outside liquidity into swaps and sending protocol fees toward UNI burns.

item.title: How Order Deadlines Shape Solver Participation
item.description: An order’s expiry decides which auctions can include it, while the solver’s block deadline sets how long it has to price, bid and settle a valid solution.

item.title: Stalled Bridge Transfer: How to Recover Destination Delivery
item.description: When a bridge transfer stalls, the tokens are still safe. Learn to trace the message, trigger a retry, and get destination delivery finally completed.

item.title: Swift readies blockchain ledger for 17-bank payment pilot
item.description: Swift says 17 banks are preparing live cross-border payment pilots on its blockchain ledger, using tokenized deposits to move funds around the clock.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars issuers from paying stablecoin interest but leaves exchange rewards to case-by-case review, shaping how crypto firms compete.

item.title: How to Trade Through Fermi Swap and Verify the Fill
item.description: Fermi swap trades run through a wallet-signed Ethereum transaction; check the receipt, token transfers and swap event to confirm what actually filled.

item.title: How Much Gas Should You Keep on the Destination Chain?
item.description: Keep enough of the destination chain’s native token for the first action after a bridge; the right reserve depends on the route and transaction.

item.title: SyncSwap: How a first swap and liquidity deposit work
item.description: SyncSwap swaps tokens through on-chain pools and lets users deposit assets to earn a share of fees, with price and liquidity risks to weigh first.

item.title: Chainflip swaps: how deposits become native-asset payouts
item.description: Chainflip records deposits on its State Chain, prices swaps against virtual liquidity, then validators sign native-asset payouts; fees combine pool, protocol and chain costs.

item.title: Mastercard opens AI agent payment APIs after six pilots
item.description: Mastercard opened Agent Pay for Machines to developers after pilots, using signed x402 payment vouchers to let AI agents buy services within approved budgets.
